title: GarageBand reverse-engineering progress
scope_note: Rough estimate of targeted format knowledge recovered, not a measure of converter completeness. Category weights express project priorities; category percentages are evidence-based judgments. The headline rounds the weighted estimate to the nearest 10%.

categories.name: Package and summary metadata
categories.basis: ZIP inventory and plist summary fields are parsed; metadata authority and cross-version differences remain open.

categories.name: Logic payload framing and event inventory
categories.basis: Chunk and event boundaries parse; IDA confirmed 68 F1 event ranges and 204 group fields across two projects. F1 semantics remain unknown.

categories.name: Audio references and placement starts
categories.basis: Starts and links recovered. TRK-015 supports relative order across six rows in one fixture; absolute indices, loop-cell role, and duration remain unknown.

categories.name: Region lengths, trims, loops, and offsets
categories.basis: Neutral MIDI source/placed extent candidates and AuRg source-window leads are retained; actual duration, trims, repeats and stretch remain open.

categories.name: MIDI placement and note semantics
categories.basis: Grouped preview retains five regions. A cached view supports 960 ticks on 26 visible notes and five measurable durations in one fixture; full timing semantics remain open.

categories.name: Tempo and meter timeline
categories.basis: Summary and unique group-zero tempo/meter candidates agree in two projects; position units, change maps, and completeness remain unresolved.

categories.name: Tracks, mixer, sections, and automation
categories.basis: Trak links and ordinal agreement support provisional MIDI bindings; identity, names, mixer state and automation remain unresolved.

milestones.name: Audio source and start recovery
milestones.state: partial: Apple Loop metadata and relative audio-row order recovered; absolute indices and cell placement unresolved

milestones.name: MIDI interpretation
milestones.state: partial: grouped FLP preview passes static checks; cached GarageBand note starts support a fixture-specific 960-tick hypothesis, while duration semantics remain open

milestones.name: Region boundaries and track state
milestones.state: partial: neutral source/placement MIDI extent candidates; duration, repeat/stretch and track state unconfirmed

milestones.name: FL Studio audio clip loading
milestones.state: partial: source-matched WAV loads; optional FFmpeg conversion available; playback unverified
